relations.description: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message contains Back-off timer value IE.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message contains 5GSM cause value IE.
When timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE starts timer T3396.
When timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE starts timer T3584.
When timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE starts timer T3585.
When timer is deactivated, UE establishes permanent back-off behavior until specific events occur.
When timer value is zero, UE stops timer T3396 and may send session management messages.
When timer value is zero, UE stops timer T3584 and may send session management messages.
When timer value is zero, UE stops timer T3585 and may send session management messages.
UE back-off behavior continues when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Back-off timer value IE guards the condition for timer activation.
Back-off timer value IE guards the condition for timer deactivation.
Back-off timer value IE guards the condition for zero timer value.
